rules.name: all-properties-are-whitelisted
rules.description: Enforce all properties are whitelisted

rules.name: all-properties-have-explicit-defined
rules.description: Enforce all properties have an explicit defined status decorator

rules.name: api-enum-property-best-practices
rules.description: Enums should use the best practices for api documentation

rules.name: api-method-should-specify-api-operation
rules.description: Api methods should at least specify the expected ApiOperation.

rules.name: api-method-should-specify-api-response
rules.description: Api methods should at least specify the expected OK response with @ApiOkResponse. But also add any error responses that might not be expected (e.g. 429)

rules.name: api-methods-should-be-guarded
rules.description: Endpoints should have authentication guards to maintain our security model.

rules.name: api-operation-summary-description-capitalized
rules.description: ApiOperation summary and description should start with an uppercase letter.

rules.name: api-property-matches-property-optionality
rules.description: Properties should have correct @ApiProperty decorators

rules.name: api-property-returning-array-should-set-array
rules.description: Properties of array should set array

rules.name: api-property-should-have-api-extra-models
rules.description: Ensures models referenced in oneOf, allOf, or anyOf within ApiProperty decorators are declared in ApiExtraModels

rules.name: controllers-should-supply-api-tags
rules.description: Controllers should supply an ApiTag to make swagger UI easier to navigate

rules.name: forward-ref-injection-should-use-wrapper-type
rules.description: Requires forwardRef constructor injections to avoid a direct runtime type reference that can fail with ESM decorator metadata.

rules.name: injectable-should-be-provided
rules.description: Public api methods should have documentation

rules.name: no-duplicate-decorators
rules.description: Some decorators should only be used once on a property or class. This rule enforces that.

rules.name: param-decorator-name-matches-route-param
rules.description: Param decorators with a name parameter e.g. Param("myvar") should match a specified route parameter - e.g. Get(":myvar")

rules.name: provided-injected-should-match-factory-parameters
rules.description: The injected items in a provider should typically match the parameters to the factory method used

rules.name: sort-module-metadata-arrays
rules.description: Ensures ASC alphabetical order for `Module` metadata arrays for easy visual scanning

rules.name: swagger-file-upload-should-be-documented
rules.description: Requires Swagger file-upload endpoints to declare multipart consumption and an API body schema.

rules.name: uploaded-file-should-be-validated
rules.description: Requires uploaded files to be validated by a file pipe or constrained by a Multer file-size limit.

rules.name: use-correct-endpoint-naming-convention
rules.description: Enforces REST API naming conventions for controller and route paths

rules.name: use-dependency-injection
rules.description: Enforce dependency injection through constructor parameters rather than property initialization. Services and controllers should not instantiate their dependencies directly.

rules.name: use-injectable-provided-token
rules.description: Prevents using APP_GUARD, APP_PIPE, APP_FILTER, or APP_INTERCEPTOR tokens with app.get() or @Inject() as these are global providers that cannot be retrieved this way.

rules.name: validate-nested-of-array-should-set-each
rules.description: If you set ValidateNested() on an array, you should set {each: true} in the options

rules.name: validated-non-primitive-property-needs-type-decorator
rules.description: A non-primitive property with validation should probably use a @Type decorator

rules.name: validation-pipe-should-use-forbid-unknown
rules.description: ValidationPipe should use forbidUnknownValues: true to prevent attacks. See https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2019-18413
